description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git hooks related to reporting status, including setup and execution of pre-receive and post-receive hooks, as well as simulating Git pack and receive operations.

methods.name: setup_receive_procReceiveRefs
methods.description: Configures Git to add receive.procReceiveRefs for a specified upstream repository.

methods.name: setup_proc_receive_hook
methods.description: Sets up a proc-receive hook using a custom test-hook script, and feeds it several references and options.

methods.name: proc-receive: report status v1
methods.description: Simulates the reception of Git objects and refs, runs the receive-pack command, captures output, and verifies the processing and status reporting logs.
